scope: Existing Mayor Vale four-room cutaway only. Original procedural box/torus/label/collision/layout/station/light sources remain authoritative.
coverage: All six box faces use room/world-metre triplanar projection, fourth-power normal weights. Continuous mirrored folds; adjacent floor rectangles share phase and density regardless of dimensions. No box UV, transform, geometry or collision change.
stroke: Family patch/reference ratio normalized once, clamped0.84-1.16 and blended0.70; tiny books/ink/glass/seams/hearth0.30. No fixed directional shadow or emitter.
cache: Immutable shared shader resources keyed by semantic family and palette. Repeated books/shelves/walls/floor/furniture and room reloads reuse resources. Original StandardMaterial3D stays on BoxMesh; override can be removed for exact original controls.
preserved: Floor footprint and seams,32 colliders including existing two source repairs,nine station feet/facing,full-party arrival/exit pocket,all furniture/wall/prop geometry,torus travel cue,labels,original four warm lamps,stable indoor environment,routines,schema8/content1.
coincident_surface_policy: Existing sofa/island/rug faces overlap the middle partition at z=-5.5. All coincident vertical fragments below0.65m share identical plaster color/patch/strength. This suppresses inherited color speckles without any vertex/depth/transform/visibility/physics edit; other cloth/timber/rug faces retain their treatment.
renderer: Godot4.7.2 Mono GL Compatibility. Existing1024RGB atlas import/mips/filter unchanged; new shader linear_mipmap/clamp sampling. Runtime uses local project assets only.
